package.name: lidar_obstacle_publisher
package.description: Real-time obstacle detection from a LiDAR point cloud, publishing the same visualization_msgs/MarkerArray contract on /arc/obstacles as synthetic_obstacle_publisher (marker.pose.position = centroid, marker.scale.x = diameter). This is the LiDAR-informed alternative to hand-entering obstacle positions -- both publish the same message type on the same topic, so single_vehicle_cbf_rate_arc does not need to know which one is running. Target sensor is a Livox Mid-360 via Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver2 (not included here -- see lidar_obstacle_publisher_node.py's docstring for required driver config), publishing sensor_msgs/PointCloud2.
